text: EVACUATION ORDER: Eaton Fire. Altadena and Sierra Madre residents must leave now. Altadena: Exit via I-210 (W). Sierra Madre: Leave now and follow directions from emergency personnel. EVACUATION WARNING: Pasadena, Arcadia, East Pasadena, San Pasqual, San Marino, Monrovia, Temple City, East San Gabriel. Be prepared to leave.
